scope: researcher-in-the-loop prioritization of the preserved 17 internal ATP synthase candidates
decision_semantics: relative computational decision support, not biological activity or success probability

balanced.description: Balance binding, ATP relevance, antibacterial prior, and developability while retaining the Phase 5 emphasis on binding.

binding_first.description: Prioritize computational binding evidence when the immediate decision is which candidates merit expensive binding calculations.

target_mechanism.description: Prioritize ATP synthase relevance when the next experiment directly measures ATP synthase function or inhibition.

translational_balance.description: Increase emphasis on antibacterial and developability evidence for a later whole-cell follow-up decision.

weight_uncertainty.method: SMAA-inspired constrained Dirichlet Monte Carlo rank acceptability
weight_uncertainty.probability_warning: Rank acceptability is conditional on the stated weight distribution and current computational evidence. It is not a probability of biological activity.

experiment_planning.primary_assay: ATP synthase functional or enzyme inhibition dose-response under one frozen protocol
experiment_planning.secondary_assay: A. baumannii MIC under one declared strain and protocol
experiment_planning.warning: The information-value score is a transparent acquisition proxy, not formal expected information gain and not an activity prediction.

evidence_policy.binding_correlation_warning: Model v3 was trained on static MM/GBSA, so model prediction, static MM/GBSA, and docking-derived evidence are not independent.
evidence_policy.external_prior_warning: ATP and antibacterial priors are cross-domain computational evidence, not measurements on the internal candidates.
